stories.headline: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks

items.title: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks
items.summary: The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.
items.fullText:
The largest Bitcoin treasury company will begin daily dividend payments on STRC in November, with three other preferred securities following in January 2027.
Bitcoin treasury company Strategy said Wednesday that shareholders approved amendments allowing its four preferred stocks to pay daily dividends, with 99.3% of votes cast in favor, according to preliminary results.
The amendments cover Strategy’s four preferred securities — STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD — shifting dividend payments from semi-monthly or quarterly schedules to every business day. Dividends will accrue daily, including weekends and holidays, without changing their annual dividend rates.
Strategy expects daily payments on STRC to begin Nov. 2, with STRF, STRK and STRD following on Jan. 4, 2027. Strategy said the changes are designed to shorten the time between earning dividends and receiving cash, while supporting liquidity and price stability in its preferred shares.
Strategy’s preferred stocks carry annual dividend rates ranging from 8% to 12%, with STRC offering a variable rate currently set at 12%. The other three securities pay fixed dividends, while STRK also gives investors the option to convert their holdings into Strategy common stock.
Related: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
Fellow Bitcoin treasury company Strive introduced daily cash dividends on its SATA preferred stock in June, months ahead of Strategy’s planned changes. The company has since launched a second preferred security, SATS, offering a fixed 15% annual dividend rate, with daily payments scheduled to begin Nov. 9, subject to declaration.
Strive closed a $630 million SATS offering on Oct. 20, selling 7 million shares at $90 each. The company said proceeds could be used for Bitcoin purchases and other corporate purposes, but has not disclosed how much it intends to allocate to the cryptocurrency.
Strategy remains the largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 848,517 BTC, while Strive ranks fourth with 43,000 BTC, according to BitcoinTreasuries.net data .

items.title: Strategy Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Preferred Stock, With 99.3% in Favor
items.summary: STRC will begin paying dividends for every calendar day from November, with STRF, STRK and STRD following in January.
items.fullText:
Strategy shareholders have approved a plan to let the company's four preferred stocks accrue dividends every calendar day, including weekends and holidays, the Bitcoin treasury company's chairman Michael Saylor said on Wednesday.
Preliminary results show 99.3% of votes cast were in favor of the amendment, which covers Strategy's STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD preferred stocks, according to Saylor. The vote took place at a special meeting of stockholders on Wednesday, the company said .
$MSTR shareholders have approved the Daily Dividends amendment. Preliminary results show 99.3% of votes cast were in favor. The amendment enables $STRF , $STRC , $STRK and $STRD to accrue dividends every calendar day. Thank you to all who voted. https://t.co/w1Cp4GKUy5
Under the new schedule, every calendar day will be a record date, with payment on the next business day. STRC will move first, with its first daily record date on November 1 and payment on November 2, Saylor added . STRF, STRK and STRD will follow, with their first record date on January 1 and payment on January 4.
The change still depends on Strategy filing amended terms for each stock, according to the filing.
Because U.S. markets are closed at weekends, dividends with record dates on non-trading days will in practice be grouped together. The Depository Trust Company will treat a weekend or holiday record date as falling on the previous business day, which Nasdaq will also treat as the ex-dividend date.
For example, dividends with record dates of Friday, November 6, Saturday, November 7 and Sunday, November 8 would all be treated as having a Friday record date and paid together on Monday, November 9, Strategy said. Because trades settle the next business day, an investor who buys STRC on that Friday would not receive any of the three dividends, while one who sells that day would still receive all three. Treatment could differ for shares traded outside Nasdaq or held through some brokers, the company said.
Strategy proposed the change last month, saying it would help dampen volatility in its preferred shares. For STRC, it means moving from 24 record dates a year to 365.
The company has been working to support STRC, which traded at $99.86 on Wednesday, just below its $100 par value, according to Yahoo Finance . Last week, Strategy paused its Bitcoin buying for the first time since mid-September and spent $204.9 million buying back STRC instead.
Strategy also faces possible removal from MSCI's widely tracked equity indexes. The index provider finalized a rule this month that treats companies whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset as ineligible, and will publish the list of affected companies on November 11.

items.title: Strategy (MSTR) Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Four Preferred Stocks
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Four Preferred Stocks Strategy (MSTR) shareholders approved paying daily dividends on four of its preferred stocks. This post Strategy (MSTR) Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Four Preferred Stocks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
items.fullText:
Strategy (MSTR) shareholders approved paying daily dividends on four of its preferred stocks.
Strategy shareholders have approved the Daily Dividends amendment, the company announced Wednesday. Preliminary results show 99.3% of votes cast were in favor, according to Executive Chairman Michael Saylor.
The amendment allows STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD to accrue dividends every calendar day, including weekends and holidays.
The proposal surfaced on September 25, when the company asked holders to attend a special meeting on October 28. Strategy said the change “would reduce reinvestment lag, enhance liquidity and market efficiency, and increase price stability.”
At the time Strategy said that they “believe these enhancements can also benefit our common stockholders by increasing the attractiveness and utility of our Digital Credit instruments, supporting our ability to access preferred equity capital efficiently and expanding the capital markets toolkit we use to execute our Bitcoin Treasury strategy.
Under the approved structure, dividends accrue every day but are paid on the next business day. Strategy has said scheduled dividend rates and total dividend obligations remain unchanged. The company has argued the change could benefit common stockholders by making its Digital Credit instruments easier to use and easier to fund.
The timing depends on board action. If the board approves the change and required filings are completed, the first STRC record and payment dates would fall on November 1 and 2, 2026. For STRF, STRK and STRD, the first record and payment dates would be January 1 and 4, 2027. Those dates also depend on operational readiness.
STRC pays a variable rate that the company can change at its discretion. Its rate for the month ended June 30, 2026 was 11.50%, according to Strategy’s quarterly report . Shareholders approved moving STRC to semi-monthly payments in June, and the new amendment builds on that precedent.
In short, STRC is designed to help Strategy raise money from investors through a preferred stock offering targeting a stable $100 price and a variable dividend yield, then use that capital to continuously buy Bitcoin regardless of its short-term price movements. This creates a potential global dollar-cost-averaging machine for Bitcoin.
Final vote certification will come in a company filing. Board action remains the final step before any new payment schedule begins.
The vote comes after bitcoin fell into somewhat of a bear market. Strategy slowed its bitcoin purchases this year and sold some holdings to fund preferred dividends, interest payments and repurchases.
The company’s common stock, MSTR, is down near 50% over the past year, though it has risen by a figure approaching 1,000% since Strategy began buying bitcoin in 2020.
Earlier this week, Strategy said they paused Bitcoin purchases for the prior week and maintained its holdings at 848,517 BTC, acquired for $64.02 billion at an average price of $75,446 per Bitcoin.
The company spent $204.9 million repurchasing STRC preferred stock while retaining a $4.83 billion cash reserve.
Fellow bitcoin-treasury company Strive pays cash dividends on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) every business day. This started on June 16, after moving from monthly payments.
